flags.issue: Call observation dates = 'each coupon observation date ... commencing January 2027' and the determination date is 'the last coupon observation date', so the final date is read literally as callable (19 levels, obs 2-20). Economically equivalent at the final date (call at 100% vs. par repayment above 60%), but verify against convention.
Filing says initial level 'is an intra-day level or the closing level ... on the trade date'; recorded exactly as printed (2,977.805; 29,825.11).
Converted from cash amount $0.235 per $10 per quarter -> 2.35%; cover says 'up to 9.40% per annum'.
Filing gives Bloomberg symbols 'RTY Index' / 'NDX Index'; recorded as RTY / NDX.
Payment-date offsets vary (3-6 days, e.g. Jan 10 2029 -> Jan 16 2029, Oct 10 2030 -> Oct 16 2030); taken from table as printed.
